name: input
title: Input
description: A single-line text field, with optional icons, buttons or text inside it and addons joined to it.

files.content: export { Input, fieldBoxStyle, inputBaseStyle, type InputProps } from './Input'

examples.name: basic
examples.title: With label
examples.code:
import { Input, Label, Text, VStack } from '@advui/core'

export default function InputBasic() {
  return (
    <VStack gap="$2" width="100%" maxWidth="$80">
      <Label htmlFor="example-email">Email</Label>
      <Input
        id="example-email"
        placeholder="you@example.com"
        inputMode="email"
        autoComplete="email"
      />
      <Text size="sm" tone="muted">
        We’ll never share your email.
      </Text>
    </VStack>
  )
}

examples.name: states
examples.title: Invalid and disabled
examples.code:
import { Input, Label, Text, VStack } from '@advui/core'

export default function InputStates() {
  return (
    <VStack gap="$4" width="100%" maxWidth="$80">
      <VStack gap="$2">
        <Label htmlFor="username">Username</Label>
        <Input id="username" defaultValue="ab" invalid aria-describedby="username-error" />
        <Text id="username-error" size="sm" tone="error">
          Username must be at least 3 characters.
        </Text>
      </VStack>
      <VStack gap="$2">
        <Label htmlFor="team" disabled>
          Team
        </Label>
        <Input id="team" defaultValue="Design" disabled />
      </VStack>
    </VStack>
  )
}

examples.name: slots
examples.title: Icons, text and buttons inside
examples.code:
import { CopyIcon, MailIcon } from '@advui/icons'
import { Field, IconButton, Input, VStack, toast } from '@advui/core'

export default function InputSlots() {
  return (
    <VStack gap="$4" width="100%" maxWidth="$80">
      <Field label="Email">
        <Input leading={<MailIcon />} placeholder="you@example.com" inputMode="email" />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Price">
        <Input leading="$" trailing="per month" placeholder="0.00" inputMode="decimal" />
      </Field>
      <Field label="API key">
        <Input
          defaultValue="demo_7Hq2xT9k"
          readOnly
          trailing={
            <IconButton
              size="sm"
              icon={<CopyIcon />}
              aria-label="Copy API key"
              onPress={() => toast('API key copied')}
            />
          }
        />
      </Field>
    </VStack>
  )
}

examples.name: addons
examples.title: Addons
examples.code:
import { Field, Input, VStack } from '@advui/core'

export default function InputAddons() {
  return (
    <VStack gap="$4" width="100%" maxWidth="$96">
      <Field label="Website">
        <Input leadingAddon="https://" trailingAddon=".com" placeholder="example" />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Weight" description="Without the packaging.">
        <Input trailingAddon="kg" placeholder="0" inputMode="decimal" size="sm" />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Amount" error="Enter an amount above 0.">
        <Input leadingAddon="USD" defaultValue="0" inputMode="decimal" size="lg" />
      </Field>
    </VStack>
  )
}
